1.description: Sun-ruled individuals are naturally friendly with Moon (2), Jupiter (3), and Mars (9). These numbers bring harmony and support. Rahu (4), Ketu (7), and Saturn (8) create obstacles and conflicts.
1.car_numbers: Choose vehicle numbers that sum to 1, 2, 3, or 9
1.phone_numbers: Phone numbers summing to 1, 2, 3, or 9 bring luck

2.description: Moon-ruled individuals are friendly with Sun (1), Moon (2), Jupiter (3), Venus (6), and Mars (9). They are emotional and need supportive numbers. Saturn (8), Rahu (4), and Ketu (7) bring emotional distress.
2.car_numbers: Choose vehicle numbers that sum to 1, 2, 6, or 9
2.phone_numbers: Phone numbers summing to 2, 6, or 9 bring emotional stability

3.description: Jupiter-ruled individuals are friendly with Sun (1), Moon (2), Jupiter (3), Venus (6), and Mars (9). These expansive numbers bring growth and prosperity. Rahu (4), Ketu (7), and Saturn (8) create obstacles in growth.
3.car_numbers: Choose vehicle numbers that sum to 3, 1, 6, or 9
3.phone_numbers: Phone numbers summing to 3, 6, or 9 bring wisdom and growth

4.description: Rahu-ruled individuals need stabilizing influences. Sun (1), Moon (2), Mercury (5), and Venus (6) provide balance. Ketu (7), Saturn (8), and Mars (9) create severe conflicts and obstacles.
4.car_numbers: Choose vehicle numbers that sum to 1, 5, or 6
4.phone_numbers: Phone numbers summing to 5 or 6 bring stability

5.description: Mercury-ruled individuals are friendly with most numbers. Sun (1), Moon (2), Jupiter (3), Mercury (5), Venus (6), and Mars (9) all support. Only Saturn (8) creates obstacles. Very adaptable nature.
5.car_numbers: Choose vehicle numbers that sum to 5, 3, 6, or 9
5.phone_numbers: Phone numbers summing to 5 or 6 bring business success

6.description: Venus-ruled individuals are harmonious with Moon (2), Jupiter (3), Mercury (5), Venus (6), and Mars (9). These numbers bring love and luxury. Ketu (7) and Saturn (8) create relationship problems.
6.car_numbers: Choose vehicle numbers that sum to 6, 3, or 9
6.phone_numbers: Phone numbers summing to 6 or 9 bring prosperity and love

7.description: Ketu-ruled individuals are spiritual and introspective. Sun (1), Moon (2), and Rahu (4) provide support. Saturn (8) creates extreme difficulties. Mars (9) brings conflicts. Need calming influences.
7.car_numbers: Choose vehicle numbers that sum to 1, 2, or 7
7.phone_numbers: Phone numbers summing to 7 enhance intuition but use cautiously

8.description: Saturn-ruled individuals face obstacles and need supportive numbers. Sun (1), Jupiter (3), Mercury (5), and Venus (6) provide relief. Rahu (4), Ketu (7), and Mars (9) increase difficulties dramatically.
8.car_numbers: Choose vehicle numbers that sum to 1, 3, 5, or 6
8.phone_numbers: Phone numbers summing to 1, 5, or 6 reduce Saturn's difficulties

9.description: Mars-ruled individuals are energetic and courageous. Sun (1), Moon (2), Jupiter (3), Venus (6), and Mars (9) bring success. Rahu (4), Ketu (7), and Saturn (8) create obstacles and conflicts.
9.car_numbers: Choose vehicle numbers that sum to 9, 1, or 3
9.phone_numbers: Phone numbers summing to 9 or 1 bring courage and success
